webhook.title: Webhooks
webhook.endpointsHint: Where this workspace's events are sent. Each is signed with its own secret.
webhook.urlHint: https:// only. The payload is signed, not encrypted.
webhook.eventsHint: An endpoint receives only what it subscribes to.
webhook.deactivateConfirm: Stop sending events to {url}? The delivery log is kept.
webhook.deliveriesHint: Every attempt, with the response. This is where "did you send it?" is answered.
webhook.secretWarning: This is the only time the secret is shown. It is encrypted at rest, so it cannot be shown again.
